name: figma-linux-next
description: Unofficial Electron-based browser wrapper for the Figma web app on Linux. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Figma, Inc.
_comment: Dependency set for the offline Flatpak build. Mirrors root package.json's build tooling (vite, svelte, electron) minus test/lint/packaging tooling that isn't needed to produce dist/ (no Playwright, no electron-builder — the Flatpak build unzips the electron-builder-managed npm 'electron' package's vendored binary directly via flatpak-node-generator's electron caching instead of running electron-builder, since electron-builder's own auxiliary tool downloads (app-builder etc.) aren't vendored offline). Keep version/name/dependencies/overrides in sync with the root package.json and src/package.json. Regenerate package-lock.json and generated-sources.json after editing (see flatpak/app.borys.FigmaLinuxNext.yml).
